tasks.title: Android: chat rows show the waiting question or current step
tasks.description:
Problem

  • Desktop chat rows show the most useful line first.

  • First a waiting question, then the current step, then the last reply.

  • The phone row shows raw screen text instead.

  • You cannot see which chat waits for your answer.

  • Desktop ticket: https://app.hypertask.ai/detail/project-2060/1665

Fix

  • Show the waiting question on the row when there is one.

  • Else show what the AI does right now.

  • Else show the last reply.

Done when

  • A chat that asks you something shows the question on its row.

  • A working chat shows its current step.

  • An idle chat shows its last reply.

Risk

  • Medium. A row could show an old line.

  • Undo: go back to the screen text.

Decision

  • none
